answer.book: A 1642 Franeker printing of Nicolaus Vedelius's Latin disputation on the magistrate's power in ecclesiastical affairs (De Episcopatu Constantini Magni), built as a dedication to the reader, a preface and commendatory letters, then the disputation itself, divided into numbered Quæstiones with annotations, responses and closing conclusions.
